profile: Owned synchronous callbacks in the expression grammar; production; top-level explicit root; no stores or hooks in Bend.
statusMeaning: Mapped functions remain restricted ports until all listed exclusions and branch obligations are closed. No source-line percentage is a proof-coverage percentage.

core/graph.ts:link.restrictions: Stable identity and generation mechanics. Slot/store release hooks remain outside the admitted grammar.

core/graph.ts:unlinkSubs.restrictions: Captured nextDep, pointer stores, callback then live dormancy guards, and exception partial state retained. Slot-release hook explicitly refuses; arbitrary callbacks unfinished.

core/heap.ts:enqueueSub.restrictions: Pointer loops carry explicit resource bounds.

core/heap.ts:actualInsertIntoHeap.restrictions: Root._parentComputed forwarding now retained and probed. Null/height representation uses Nat and stable IDs; no store slot hooks.

core/heap.ts:insertIntoHeap.restrictions: Same flag tests, marking posture and intrusive bucket insertion on the admitted graph.

core/heap.ts:insertIntoHeapHeight.restrictions: Same flags and intrusive insertion; top-level root representation.

core/heap.ts:deleteFromHeap.restrictions: Explicit null IDs, no slot nodes.

core/heap.ts:markNode.restrictions: Depth-first explicit worklist preserves subscriber order; traversal budget is an explicit assumption until generalized progress proof.

core/heap.ts:markHeap.restrictions: Ordered intrusive bucket walks with resource bounds.

core/heap.ts:runHeap.restrictions: Continuation dispatch replaces callback recursion; zombie/tracked-effect routing remains open.

core/heap.ts:adjustHeight.restrictions: Same dependency traversal and height propagation for admitted nodes.

core/core.ts:signal.restrictions: Separate production literal and signal-only ownedWrite/noSnapshot masks; optional extension installer retained as callback identity. Snapshot capture unfinished; restricted unobserved programs execute; no custom comparators.

core/core.ts:computed.restrictions: Separate production literal with source config arms, loading-value presence, lazy/initial status and lazy extension; parent scope/height setup. Hydration IDs, external/snapshot hooks, custom comparators and async results unfinished. Host options are typed data, not getters.

core/core.ts:setupComputedNode.restrictions: Source prevHeap self -> child link -> root-forwarded parent height -> eager recompute. Hydration ID accounting, external/snapshot/dev/observe hooks unfinished.

core/core.ts:recompute.bend: runtime/core.bend:recompute, prepareRecompute, recomputePrepared, catchStatus, catchPass, passFinally, finish, afterPass, publish, unwind
core/core.ts:recompute.restrictions: Source teardown/parking, synchronous body catch, clearStatus, finally restoration, dead-pass freeze, publication and same-value error recovery retained. Error wrapper identities survive propagation. Pending/async, stageError, transactions/lanes/snapshots, arbitrary comparators and nested construction remain unfinished.

core/core.ts:updateIfNecessary.restrictions: Sync status-free nodes; error retry and remaining retained flag postures open.

core/core.ts:prepareComputed.restrictions: Lazy activation, dormant relinking/reawakening, zombie splice exemption and dead-parent freeze retained. refresh=true routing and other public status consumers remain unfinished.

core/core.ts:pullComputed.restrictions: No fresh-read waiter config or verdict propagation; exact height-gated pull on the supported path.

core/core.ts:read.bend: runtime/core.bend:readNode, readPrepared, readSignalFast, prepareSlow, serve; runtime/core.bend:readStatus, afterServe
core/core.ts:read.restrictions: Source fast/slow paths, linking/root forwarding, dormant tail, error throw and later-cycle tracked retry retained. Pending, snapshots, verdict windows, held transactions and strict-read hooks remain unfinished.

core/core.ts:serve.restrictions: Source order of unflushed probe, late-linker latch, committed selection and staged flag retained. Born-staged NotReady and staged errors refuse explicitly; held stash, spectating, verdict hooks and exception/status propagation unfinished.

core/core.ts:setSignal.restrictions: One shared setter for host and callback writes. Source equality, promotion, computed time and notified-epoch rewrite retained. Held/lane/snapshot/write hooks and arbitrary comparators remain unfinished.

core/core.ts:untrack.restrictions: Tracking restored at successful and exceptional return points. Reactive compute catches/status propagation and external-untrack hooks remain unfinished.

core/scheduler.ts:queuePendingNode.restrictions: Source append then markUnflushedStaged outside the running window. Dev attribution not implemented.

core/scheduler.ts:bumpNotifyEpoch.restrictions: Unbounded mathematical Nat in proofs; emitted host natural-number range must be respected.

core/scheduler.ts:insertSubs.restrictions: Generation-current missed-wake condition and notify epoch retained; callback writes use this same path. Snapshot/observe hooks unfinished.

core/scheduler.ts:commitPendingNode.restrictions: Source separate signal/computed paths, configuration/publication order, metadata gates and parked teardown integrated; callback throws stop at source edges. Staged-error propagation explicitly refuses; no async/held transaction execution claim.

core/scheduler.ts:commitPendingNodes.restrictions: Live intake bound, held/override guard, clear only after successful walk; callback appends and throwing cleanup partial states are compared. No transactions/lanes.

core/scheduler.ts:GlobalQueue.flush.bend: runtime/core.bend:round, heapLoop, seam, RenderQueue, UserQueue, FlushFinally, RoundEnd
core/scheduler.ts:GlobalQueue.flush.restrictions: Source running/resync/dormancy/heap/settle/clock/queue ordering and exceptional running restoration; callback writes drain through same rounds. Error halt guard retained in public flush. Transactions/boundaries remain unfinished.

core/scheduler.ts:GlobalQueue.settle.restrictions: Mainline live pending/held-trim walks, source nullish error/modified trim gate and clearing after walks. Transaction/lane seams, store commit and boundary hooks unfinished.

core/scheduler.ts:flush.restrictions: Explicit host-driven drain with source halt/running/scheduled guards. Microtask delivery, flush(fn), actions and transaction landing unfinished.

core/effect.ts:effect.restrictions: Separate compute/apply/error phases, schedule/defer/user options and returned cleanup program. Staged/transaction/lane creation and hold hooks unfinished.

core/effect.ts:runEffect.restrictions: Success/previous-cleanup/returned-cleanup path, compute-error user arm, explicit cleanup helper, callback/error-handler throw escalation, fresh wrapper versus raw escaping payload, finally and overriding trim throws retained. Restricted programs; boundaries/held-run hooks and arbitrary callbacks remain unfinished.

core/owner.ts:linkChild.restrictions: Stable same-identity owner/computed nodes, head insertion and both sibling pointers.

core/owner.ts:disposeChildren.bend: runtime/owner.bend:enter, afterPark, walk, PrepareChild, AfterChild, finish, runDisposal, effectCleanup
core/owner.ts:disposeChildren.restrictions: Live recursive return points, graph last-subscriber hooks, parked/current frames and reentry retained. Integrated with commit/recompute/unobserved consumers. Restricted programs; arbitrary JS callbacks/dev/observe unfinished.

core/owner.ts:dispose.restrictions: Computed clears AUTO then source unobserved path (deleteHeap, clearDeps, disposeChildren); root self path. Full iterator settlement and public callback facade unfinished.

core/core.ts:markRefresh.restrictions: Production invalidation branch now follows target flag update -> insertIntoHeap -> schedule, including REASK classification. Dev/observe hooks and async reask metadata are unfinished. The public refresh waiter API is not implemented.

core/core.ts:stagedRead.bend: runtime/core.bend:stagedRead; serve invokes it on staged selection
core/core.ts:stagedRead.restrictions: Source REACTIVE_STAGED_READ flag and uninitialized guard are retained in the synchronous profile. Lane stagedReaders collection and callers in other unported paths remain unfinished.

core/core.ts:markUnflushedStaged.restrictions: Module boolean is a World field, set by the actual pending intake.

core/core.ts:readerSeesCommitted.restrictions: Source no-reader/no-staging/children-forbidden predicate. Does not implement tracked-effect API.

core/core.ts:unflushedValue.restrictions: Source running/no-staging/promoted guards, held flushedAt/flushed branch and committed Slot. A held node missing its required extension explicitly refuses as an invalid representation. Full held read/join behavior unfinished.

core/core.ts:markLateLinker.restrictions: Source MISSED_WAKE latch; source true return is implicit in the serve branch.

core/core.ts:notePromotedWrite.restrictions: Source guards, config bit and once-only append, now called by actual callback writes. No additional eager publication inferred from comments.

core/core.ts:resyncUnflushedCompanions.restrictions: Source flag reset, length guard, promotion-bit walk and clear. Called at the actual flush entry; no alternate scheduler.

core/core.ts:stashFlushed.restrictions: Source same-clock first-stash preservation, flushed/flushedAt writes and unflushed flag. Direct helper probes include staged undefined. Held setSignal caller/joining unfinished.

core/core.ts:ext.restrictions: All source default slots retained with explicit nullable identities and sentinels; one lazy arena allocation reused on subsequent calls. Flight, callback, pending-source, snapshot and transaction data are not implementations of their engines; see tracking/representation.md.

core/core.ts:createEffectNode.restrictions: Separate production effect literal, own config arms, forced lazy/uninitialized, equals false and modified/previous defaults; lazy setup. No hydration IDs, snapshots/external hooks or arbitrary callback/error/cleanup protocol.

core/owner.ts:createOwner.restrictions: Separate production root literal, inherited scope identity, parentComputed forwarding and child linking. Hydration IDs, public context-map APIs, root callback/disposer method facade and dev/observe hooks unfinished.

core/owner.ts:runDisposal.restrictions: Absent/single/list forms, detach before callback and reverse order. Reentry and explicit throws unwind core finally frames. Arbitrary receiver inspection/captured array mutation outside protocol.

core/owner.ts:cleanup.restrictions: Null owner early return and absent/single/list registration retained; explicit owner comes from the host runWithOwner boundary. The known callback identity is an implicit return in the state-threaded ABI.

core/owner.ts:disposeRootSelf.restrictions: Root death routes through source disposeChildren; public root callback/disposer method ABI remains unfinished.

core/graph.ts:unobserved.restrictions: Source heap deletion, dependency teardown, then owner self-disposal. Restricted callback ABI and explicit budget.

core/graph.ts:sweepDormant.restrictions: Ordered unique-ID Set representation, live sweep bound and source eligibility guards; clear only on success. Pending guards tested synthetically; async settlement unfinished.

core/core.ts:parkChildren.restrictions: Mark descendants zombie before moving child/disposal heads into lazy extension. Consumed by actual commit and recompute.

core/owner.ts:markDisposal.restrictions: Source recursive marking in live child order; callback construction/IDs unfinished.

core/async.ts:releaseFlightTeardown.restrictions: Detach teardown before invocation; cancellation ordering and throw state compared. Actual async iterator protocol unfinished.

core/async.ts:clearStatus.restrictions: Source pending-set drop, blocked truthy clear, status mask, truthy error reset and effect notifier. Actual async landing/retirement callers unfinished; direct pending metadata probes are not async execution.

core/async.ts:notifyStatus.restrictions: Synchronous STATUS_ERROR arm preserves wrappers, clears source set, writes status/error, invokes effect notifier or propagates. Pending/NotReady, block-status effect arguments, lane and boundary routing unfinished.

core/async.ts:propagateStatus.restrictions: Error arm uses live subscriber order, time stamps, rederive/verdict enqueue, reference-identity deduplication, pending intake and recursive notification. Pending-source branches unfinished.

core/async.ts:settleErroredDependents.restrictions: Visited Set as unique IDs, same-error enqueue and one final schedule. Invoked by actual unchanged-value recovery; pending counterpart unfinished.

core/effect.ts:notifyEffectStatus.restrictions: Unblocked synchronous error queues user error arm or halts/rethrows render error; clear is inert at root. Pending, blocked forwarding and boundary hooks unfinished.

core/error.ts:unwrapStatusError.restrictions: Unwraps one StatusFailure layer. Arbitrary host Error objects/functions as payload data outside grammar.

core/scheduler.ts:haltReactivity.restrictions: Once-only halt plus explicit production report. Host reportError channel not installed in admitted host; console output represented as ordered reports.

core/scheduler.ts:schedule.restrictions: Source halt guard, once-only ignored-update report and scheduled flag. Host microtask delivery intentionally manual in the harness; no event-loop theorem.

core/scheduler.ts:resetErrorHalt.restrictions: Resets halted and first-ignored-update notification, as source test/dev reload hook.

policy: Operation-level source fidelity is required. Formal TS/Bend equivalence is not required. Restricted and partial entries are location mappings, not completed line-by-line alignment. See tracking/source-fidelity.md.
